source: RI-STL02 §3, and seam S21. Tier requirements and pick costs are RI-PRG03 §6 verbatim.
ruling: Lockpicking does not keep a probability roll. There is no per-attempt success chance, no hidden die, and no retry loop that converges on success. Locks are opened by a deterministic, skill-gated, input-expressive interaction, and a lock you cannot open stays shut until your Security is higher or you find another way in.
s21: A retry-able roll is not a gate; it is a tax on time. A 12%-per-attempt chance is a 100% chance of opening the lock after an average of 8 attempts. The gate lives in the skill (Morrowind); the uncertainty lives in the player's hands (Souls).
rng_draws_rule: The RNG counter must not move during a lock interaction AT ALL. That single assertion catches all three side doors at once: a critical-failure chance on the pick, a Luck term on breakage, and 'a small random jitter on the collar rate so it doesn't feel robotic'.

below_requirement.prompt: You do not know this kind of lock.
below_requirement.rule: RI-PRG03's deterministic gate, and it is absolute. Below the tier's Security OR Agility requirement the interaction is not offered at all.

ward_collar.ward_angles: fixed per lock instance, authored in the interior data, never generated

tell.what: the pick visibly flexes and the audio changes

ward_collar.tolerance_formula: W = clamp( 4 + 0.55 * (Security - req_tier), 4, 34 ) degrees, centred on ward_angle[i]
ward_collar.press_inside_W: ward set, permanently, for this attempt
ward_collar.all_wards_set: open, permanently, for the rest of the game
ward_collar.input_note: No new button. HARNESS.md §4's set is closed and the only name W1-15 adds to it is `crouch`. Collar rotation is automatic; the player only times.

worked_tier3.feels_like: brutal - three wards, three near-frame-perfect inputs

ward_collar.worked_note: RI-STL02's table prints W = 12.3 at Security 55; 4 + 0.55*15 = 12.25 exactly. The item rounded to 3 s.f. The formula is authoritative and the probe asserts 12.25.

unbind_spell.cost_note: strictly MORE expensive per door than picking
unbind_spell.refused_by: the 4 quest-variant tier-5 locks, which need the key
unbind_spell.why_refused: a spell that opens everything is a level-design solvent (S19)

no_lockout.rule: Locks are never the only way in.

how_the_angles_were_produced.method: An authored palette of 24 collar positions (the ward stops a Saxhleel brass-smith actually cuts) plus a per-lock authored offset, assembled by tools/world/build-property.mjs and COMMITTED as data. Not rng(seed + lockId).
how_the_angles_were_produced.why_a_palette: RI-STL02 method 5 requires the multiset of angles across the world to FAIL a chi-square test against uniform over 10-degree bins (p < 0.01), because authored data clusters and generated data does not. A 24-stop palette clusters by construction: 24 of the 36 bins carry weight and 12 carry none.
how_the_angles_were_produced.honesty: This is assembly from an authored palette, not 819 hand-typed vectors. The palette, the per-lock offsets and the no-duplicate-vector-per-interior rule are authored; the assembly is deterministic and its output is committed JSON a critic can read. Stated plainly rather than presented as hand-authoring.
